seo__search_description: Volunteer in the community at Oakdene House Foundation — supporting the Kitchen, Boutique, Laundrette and community programs in Fairfield, Western Sydney.
hero__intro: A direct and practical way to give back to your community.
overview__text: Community volunteers are part of the day-to-day life of Oakdene House. They support practical service delivery, help create a welcoming atmosphere and bring energy and connection to our programs.
overview__text_2: Volunteering here is hands-on, meaningful, and valued by the people we support.
overview__image_alt: Smiling volunteer serving food at Oakdene Kitchen
what_we_look_for__heading: What we look for in volunteers
what_we_look_for__text: No formal qualifications are required. A genuine interest in supporting people and a respectful attitude are what matter most.
cta__subheading: Submit an application and our team will be in touch to discuss next steps.
data__look_for: A willingness to contribute in a team environment
A commitment to Oakdene's values and community focus
